name: Deepdale
lore: A patient tunnel listener from the buried rail clans, Deepdale maps safe ground by the pitch of stressed metal and the drift of black dust.

abilities.name: Black Dust Craft
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Forge on yellow Hazard tests.

abilities.name: Lantern Delver
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Signal on blue Hazard and Anomaly tests.
